newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nippon Express plans new Schiphol warehouse.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Express plans new Schiphol warehouse.

text.p: Nippon Express Netherlands BV, the Dutch wing of forwarder Nippon Express Co, is to build a new warehouse and distribution centre at Schiphol airport, a spokesman said.

The new facility will be built in two phases and is to be located at the Schiphol's Airport Business Park on the south side of the Dutch airport. The cost of the new project was not immediately available.
Speaking in a telephone interview the spokesman said the first phase will be completed by August 1997, and will be used to relieve existing facilities at the airport.
He said more space is required to expand business and to provide storage, distribution and pre-processing services.
The first phase will consist of 13,000 sq.metres of warehousing and 1,500 sq.metres of office space.
Phase two will be ready by February 1999, and will give Nippon Express an extra 6,000 sq.metres of warehousing, the spokesman said.
The new facility will be used both for ocean and airfreight, he added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+171-171-542-5017
